frozen_before_reading: any a9 result document under workstreams/po03/control/units/a9/
scope: Applies to a9-u01..a9-u04 (functions F2/F10, zero-base strategy challenge and open discovery), quoted verbatim from workstreams/po03/control/dispatch/a9-u01.json..a9-u04.json. a9 is disposed (not re-executed unit-by-unit like a4) as part of a10-u04.

per_unit_bars.claim: A zero-base challenge identifies at least one load-bearing assumption the current plan's evidence does not support.
per_unit_bars.pass_bar: zero-base-challenge.json states at least one concrete assumption, cites the specific committed evidence it was tested against (a real path/artifact, not a general appeal), and reaches an explicit upheld/flagged verdict per assumption.
reject_triggers: a challenge is stated with no evidence citation
any 'flagged' proposal is treated in later work as though it already changed a decision (would violate decision_changed: [] and the acceptance's falsified_if)

per_unit_bars.claim: At least three materially different coordination topologies exist and are compared on measured properties.
per_unit_bars.pass_bar: Three or more topologies are specified with enough concreteness that this reviewer could implement a toy simulation from the description alone, and the comparison uses either real Wave A data (this reviewer will spot-check at least one cited number against the actual ledger/registry) or a runnable simulation this reviewer can execute.
reject_triggers: topologies are named but not specified concretely
comparison numbers do not match the underlying data when spot-checked

per_unit_bars.claim: There is useful in-scope work neither the founder nor the commission named, and it is implemented and tested, not merely proposed.
per_unit_bars.pass_bar: A component exists under the PO-03 allowlist with an executable test this reviewer can run under python3 -I -m unittest, and it is genuinely something not already explicitly named as a mandatory output/mission item in COMMISSION.md.
reject_triggers: the 'discovery' restates a component already mandated elsewhere in COMMISSION.md's mandatory outputs list
no test exists or the test does not pass when this reviewer runs it

per_unit_bars.claim: An executable semantic check catches operator-taxonomy/state-contract ambiguities and does not weaken scripts/check_operator_taxonomy.py.
per_unit_bars.pass_bar: The check runs standalone under the PO-03 allowlist, this reviewer independently runs scripts/check_operator_taxonomy.py before and after a9's change (read-only comparison, since scripts/** is read-only to this reviewer) and confirms it still passes with unchanged semantics.
reject_triggers: scripts/check_operator_taxonomy.py behavior changes as a side effect
the check requires editing anything outside the allowlist

cohort_level_disposition_rule.ACCEPTED: Every unit meets its pass_bar with artifacts this reviewer can independently inspect/run, and no reject_trigger is observed.
cohort_level_disposition_rule.REJECTED: Any reject_trigger is observed, or a claim is prose-only where the acceptance contract requires an executable artifact.
